page.notes: The numeral at item 5 is printed as a long, hooked character (ʃ) and is transcribed as seen. The hyphenated "mo-" at the line end of the last full paragraph is partly obscured by a stain, so "ribus" is read with some doubt. The "M" of "Metaphysicæ" is a decorated letter and is transcribed as an ordinary M. The paragraph beginning "ATque" is set in italic throughout, so the whole of it is marked in italic.
